verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a KYC process for consumer account holders with bypass/exempt options (KYC_BYO, KYC_EXEMPT), implying data requirements exist, but there is no explicit documentation of KYB for business account holders, review states, or re-verification flows. missing for 10: explicit KYB documentation for business entities, documented review/decision states (pending/approved/rejected), re-verification/periodic refresh flow details.
